notes.title: Resonance FAQ
notes.content: [h2]Hello everyone 🙌[/h2][p][/p][p]Naturally, you must have a lot of questions following the Reveal Trailer. Here are some answers we can bring already! 😉  [/p][p][/p][h3]➡️ What is [i]Resonance[/i]?[/h3][p][/p][p][b][i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] stands as a prequel to the first two [i]A Plague Tale[/i] games[/b]: [i]Innocence[/i] and [i]Requiem[/i]. It is set 15 years before Requiem. [/p][p][/p][p]You'll play as Sophia, a fierce young plunderer, on the run and determined to uncover the secrets of her past. Dive into an original story blending combat, myth and fate with a brand new take in the universe of [i]A Plague Tale[/i]. Sophia’s journey leads to the Minotaur's Island, where she faces deadly trials, navigates treacherous trails, solves puzzles, all while fighting and staying one step ahead of the army chasing her. But the true challenge awaits, as the terrifying creature hidden behind the myth will soon resonate with her…   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/1f81ed8e038f18d4b1ead583ae6096eabd03010f.png"][/img] [/p][p]As you journey deeper into the island’s heart, [b]you’ll confront the truth behind a long-buried curse[/b].  [/p][list][*][p] Followed by many enemies, each drawn to the Island to reclaim a mysterious treasure, you must navigate a treacherous maze. Rely on your agility, tricks and sharp reflexes to outsmart enemies, perfect your parries, and unleash powerful strikes to survive deadly encounters. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Shift between the Middle Age of Sophia and ancient Minoan times, where echoes of the past shape the battles of the present. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Unfold a new story in the universe of [i]A Plague Tale[/i], through the entwined destinies of two heroes linked by fate and the Macula’s mysterious legacy. Guided by the knowledge safeguarded in your notebook, follow in your crew’s footsteps to explore a richly detailed world, unravel its secrets, and face deadly trials.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Use a stolen Minoan sphere to solve ingenious puzzles by manipulating light - a force woven by Daedalus into the island’s very heart. It is said that only a few came back from the island. Lurking in the shadows lives a restless presence. It follows you around, seemingly knowing your every move, as it hunts through the island’s depths. Every step is a risk. Every pause, a potential end. You can’t stop, only hide, outsmart, and push forward.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/bcc2c6f7527eabd14e7935b5db37c8f24e3cf389.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]➡️ Do I need to play [i]Innocence[/i] and/or [i]Requiem[/i] to enjoy [i]Resonance[/i]?[/h3][p][/p][p]Even if it is a prequel, there is no need to have played either [i]A Plague Tale: Innocence[/i] nor [i]Requiem[/i] to enjoy [i]Resonance[/i] and get the full experience of it!  [/p][p][/p][h3]➡️ Which platform will Resonance be on?[/h3][p][/p][p][i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] will be available on PC, Xbox Series X|S and PS5! We'll make sure to communicate the required specs prior to the launch.  [/p][p][/p][h3]➡️ When will the game be available?[/h3][p][/p][p]The release date of [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] has not been announced yet. But the game is planned to be released in 2026! Until then, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy?utm_campaign=RAPTL_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=Steam#wishlist"]make sure you wishlist the game[/url]![/p][p][/p][h3]➡️ Who is developping the game?[/h3][p][/p][p][i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] is developed by Asobo Studio, a talented and devoted French studio, located in Bordeaux, France, and published by Focus Entertainment. The same partnership behind our previous titles, [i]A Plague Tale: Innocence[/i] and [i]A Plague Tale: Requiem[/i].  [/p][p][/p][h3]➡️ How can I support the game?[/h3][p][/p][p]The first step you can take is to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy?utm_campaign=RAPTL_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=Steam#wishlist"]wishlist the game[/url]! ⭐[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651860/cb9ee20792a7ed653b756d244bf9ea20629d5968.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And finally, join our already wide community on [url="https://discord.gg/focusent"]Discord[/url]!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/853d6a594e1f659189475f52279481a3c7325395.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h3]With much love,  [/h3][h3]From the Focus and Asobo teams! 💫 [/h3]

notes.title: Revealing Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy for 2026 🎉
notes.content: [h2]Greetings everyone,[/h2][p][/p][p]Our hearts are pounding at the idea that this is happening. We're so excited to announce and finally reveal [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] to the public. 🎉🎉🥹  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy?utm_campaign=RAPTL_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=Steam#wishlist"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Embark on an original story, prequel to the first two [i]A Plague Tale[/i] games. As Sophia, journey to the Minotaur’s Island, outsmart deadly foes, unravel ancient secrets, and confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse.   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Watch the Reveal Trailer now, don't miss a bit of it![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="lroYak-ryyM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]🗡️ What will [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] be like?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p] [b]STRONG, FIERCE AND LETHAL[/b] [/p][p]Sophia is a skilled, agile, and strong-willed fighter who engages in dynamic and violent melee combat. Followed by many enemies, each drawn to the Island to reclaim a mysterious treasure, you must navigate a treacherous maze. Rely on your agility, tricks and sharp reflexes to outsmart enemies, perfect your parries, and unleash powerful strikes to survive deadly encounters.   [/p][p][/p][p][b]BOUNDED BY LEGACY[/b] [/p][p]Shift between the Middle Age of Sophia and ancient Minoan times, where echoes of the past shape the battles of the present. Unfold a new story in the universe of [i]A Plague Tale[/i], through the entwined destinies of two heroes linked by fate and the Macula’s mysterious legacy. [/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651860/ec66133c216482fc72916dbeedd5827458c0c139.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651860/892199e136bfe7e929ed1f9c8cc3b835b06a0e71.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][b]A MYTHICAL ISLAND[/b] [/p][p]Guided by the knowledge safeguarded in your notebook, follow in your crew’s footsteps to explore a richly detailed world, unravel its secrets, and face deadly trials. Use a stolen Minoan sphere to solve ingenious puzzles by manipulating light - a force woven by Daedalus into the island’s very heart.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IN THE MIST OF SHADOWS[/b] [/p][p]It is said that only a few came back from the island. Lurking in the shadows lives a restless presence. It follows you around, seemingly knowing your every move, as it hunts through the island’s depths.   Every step is a risk. Every pause, a potential end. You can’t stop, only hide, outsmart, and push forward. Can you survive each trial and every step or will you join those who never came back? [/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651860/f59b0e4820a23c11ddbd800554dc879c00b752f4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651860/b66dd9a69b0a0ea916b72c7113067f77ee1432e3.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]Wishlist it now!🌟[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Click here to already put [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] in your wishlist on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy?utm_campaign=RAPTL_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=Steam#wishlist" style="button"]Steam[/url]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Keep yourself updated on [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] 🧡[/b][/h3][p] [/p][h3]Follow us on our socials[/h3][p]Naturally, you must be eager to see more of it! Until our next big announcement, please make sure you follow our socials. There we will share news on [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i], but we also chit chat a lot about the other Plague Tale games! So, join us 🥰 [/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/aplaguetale" style="button"]INSTAGRAM[/url] [url="https://www.facebook.com/APlagueTale" style="button"]FACEBOOK[/url] [url="https://discord.gg/DG339RvM" style="button"]DISCORD[/url] [url="https://x.com/APlagueTale" style="button"]X[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Join our forum[/h3][p]To be updated with the latest news, you should also become a member of [url="https://community.focus-entmt.com/focus-entertainment/a-plague-tale-series"]Focus Together[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651860/b481b267b6516c85b8f56c58ac31bdcfe6879a8d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Stay tuned 😉[/h3]
